name: Naveen Kandakumar
headline: Senior Software Developer at Hyland
summary: Senior software developer with a background in C#, Python, .NET, AWS. Experience includes Hyland Software, a CRM internship at Frontier Internet, and consulting for The Nielsen Company through Tata Consultancy Services.

experience.title: Software Developer
highlights: Currently working on a Content Innovation Cloud (CIC) connector to integrate Workday with the CIC platform.
Works on enterprise application integration at Hyland Software, a software company focused on healthcare and document management solutions.

experience.title: CRM Intern
highlights: Collaborated with a four-person team to maintain and upgrade Frontier’s customer-relationship management application built with JSPs and HTML.
Implemented UI and workflow updates that improved how support staff viewed and updated customer records in the CRM.
Designed and developed an internal Java Swing desktop tool backed by Oracle 10g to log team assignments, track progress, and report status.
Used the tracking app to give the team a shared view of ownership and completion across open CRM tasks.

experience.title: Assistant Systems Engineer
highlights: Worked as a TCS consultant assigned to The Nielsen Company on portal and reporting solutions.
Developed J2EE web applications that generated e-reports for Nielsen stakeholders.
Built a content repository with role-based permissions so users could only view authorized portlets.
Maintained and enhanced Vignette portal applications used by Nielsen teams for day-to-day content access.
Collaborated with on-site and offshore teammates to deliver fixes and feature updates for the client portal.
